description: Cloudflare Pages Caching and Security Configuration

rules.name: HTML - Always Revalidate
rules.description: HTML files should never be cached to detect new deployments

rules.name: Assets with Hash - 1 Year
rules.description: Versioned assets can be cached permanently (hash in filename = cache busting)

rules.name: Images - 1 Year
rules.description: Images are versioned, safe to cache for 1 year

rules.name: Fonts - 1 Year
rules.description: Fonts can be cached for extended periods

rules.name: API Responses - 1 Hour with Revalidation
rules.description: API responses cached for 1 hour, serve stale for 24h if origin is down

rules.name: Manifest and Service Worker
rules.description: Config files should be revalidated frequently

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://supabase.com https://*.supabase.co;

minification.description: Enable automatic minification of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

compression.description: Enable Brotli compression (preferred) and gzip fallback

image_optimization.description: Automatically serve optimized images in WebP and AVIF formats

web_analytics.description: Track page performance and visitor metrics

graphql_analytics.description: Use GraphQL for detailed analytics queries

cache_rules.then: cache for 1 year with cache-control: max-age=31536000, immutable
